title: Haryana TET HTET 2024 E Certificate 2026
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bseh.org.in or HTET result/certificate portal
2. Open HTET 2024 E-Certificate download link
3. Enter roll number / application number and DOB
4. View and download e-certificate PDF
5. Take printout for recruitment applications
shortDescription: Haryana HTET 2024 E-Certificate download 2026 – get digital TET certificate from BSEH official portal.
content:
Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) issues HTET e-certificates to qualified candidates of Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test.

Candidates who qualified HTET 2024 can download the digital certificate online using roll number and date of birth. Keep a printed copy for school recruitment and document verification.

Portal: bseh.org.in.
